items.name: sse-channel
items.title: defineSseRoute (server) + useSseChannel (client)
items.description: Server-Sent Events helpers. defineSseRoute returns a route handler with heartbeat ping every 15s + cleanup on client abort. useSseChannel is the client subscriber with auto-reconnect + exponential back-off + JSON-parsing.

items.name: use-presence
items.title: usePresence (Upstash Redis-backed)
items.description: Active-viewer presence — beats a heartbeat endpoint on a configurable interval AND when the tab regains focus, polls a members endpoint for the live list. Returns `{ users, others, isLoading }`. Server endpoints sketched in the file's JSDoc.
